diagnostics.text: An earlier batch-15 record documents a team lead-approved engineering handoff for three disabled-Submit reports after required fields were filled; the recorded outcome remained open, with no confirmed shared cause, repair or successful submission.
An engineer requests the LT error state and time for tasks RP-3412 and RP-5337 and states that the wider cause is not confirmed in those threads.
The team lead's batch-15 announcement directs people to keep Submit-problem examples in its thread while scope is checked.
diagnostics.rationale: As a description of the announcement, this is accurate: the team lead asks people to keep examples in its thread while scope is checked. This does not independently establish qualifying announcement handling; its use as an action premise is voided by the failed handling dependency.

diagnostics.text: The team lead requested diagnostic details in all four threads and said submission status remains unverified; an earlier batch-15 engineering handoff recorded similar disabled-button reports without a confirmed shared cause or repair.
diagnostics.rationale: Both the four diagnostic requests and the historical handoff description are supported. However, the listed AUTHOR attribution to U001 for the handoff record is not established: the source identifies U001 as the approving and handoff-recording actor, not as the author of the retrieved manual record.

diagnostics.text: Report a technical issue to engineering. Instruction: Collect the requested diagnostics in the existing example thread and send engineering a consolidated update, checking the earlier handoff's latest status before linking the new cases to it. Draft to copy: Submission problems in batch 15 need investigation. A QA tutor and a tutor report a grey Submit button after picking B; a tutor reports that clicking Submit does nothing; a QA tutor reports being unable to submit after finishing the rubric; another tutor reports a disabled button after completing every field. Task references include RP-3412, RP-1577, RP-5337 and RP-3325. We are collecting required-field state, exact button behavior, error state and time in the existing example thread. Please assess these examples and check whether they match the earlier handoff. Submission status remains unverified; no common cause is established. Scope: This is an update for engineering, not a new policy or a confirmed link to the earlier incident. Collect missing diagnostics first; do not prescribe browser zoom as a universal fix.
diagnostics.rationale: The reported symptoms, task references, diagnostic collection, cautious engineering update, and refusal to assume a common cause are supported. The exact instruction to collect in the existing announcement example thread relies on an announcement-handling premise that fails the required test. The rejected premises also provide no support.

diagnostics.text: This announcement applies to this topic and directs current handling: "Please keep examples in this thread while we check the scope.". The team lead's announcement concerns Submit failures in the same project and batch and directs example collection. Its context reply is not used as an additional affected-member report or as authority for handling.
diagnostics.rationale: The announcement concerns the same batch and symptoms, and the quotation matches. However, its directive is only example collection while scope is checked. An example-collection note does not establish current topic handling under the stated verification criteria.
